purpose: Reliable natural scheduled persistence inside the observed short automation runtime by minimizing pre-write tool calls and using GitHub optimistic concurrency as the durability gate.

root_cause_basis.failure_pattern: Runs with multiple sequential GitHub reads and slower optional retrievals frequently ended before the authoritative update; faster paths persisted.

runtime_identity.source: hard-bound scheduler prompt plus out-of-band control-plane audit

transaction: Fetch only <lane>/latest.json immediately before mutation and retain its current blob SHA as PREVIOUS_BLOB_SHA.
Perform at most one bounded work call. If that call is unavailable, slow, stale, incomplete, or uncertain, skip depth and persist a truthful degraded/no-new-evidence receipt.
Build one self-contained RUN_RECEIPT using the exact hard-bound lane identity and protocol.
Update <lane>/latest.json exactly once using PREVIOUS_BLOB_SHA. A successful GitHub contents API response is the authoritative write acknowledgement.
Do not perform a mandatory post-write readback inside the scheduled run. Out-of-band acceptance audits verify the stored blob and commit history.

optimistic_concurrency.rule: A CAS conflict or write error is a failed run. Do not spend the remaining scheduler budget retrying; the next natural invocation starts from fresh state.

runtime_budget.rule: If optional depth threatens the write deadline, skip optional depth and persist a truthful degraded receipt.

scheduler_jitter.rule: Use the nominal slot in scheduled_for. Actual trigger jitter within tolerance does not invalidate a run.

legacy_artifacts.v3: heartbeat.json, checkpoint.json, core/, history/, finalization/ are read-only historical evidence.
legacy_artifacts.v4_0: Existing v4.0 latest.json commits are historical evidence. New natural runs must write v4.1 receipts.

acceptance.single_run: One natural v4.1 receipt stored by successful CAS with all required fields and exact identity.
acceptance.sustained_lane: Two consecutive natural v4.1 receipts with distinct RUN_IDs and distinct latest.json blob SHAs.
acceptance.stack_5_of_5: All five lanes satisfy sustained_lane while the scheduler registry remains exactly five enabled authoritative lanes.
